title: Dynam3D: Dynamic Layered 3D Tokens Empower VLM for Vision-and-Language Navi

predicted_errors.error_location: Section 4.6, paragraph on Robustness to Noise, and Table 7
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The text states: 'In addition to these, we perform ablation by degrading the quality of 3D instance and zone embeddings through feature dropout and spatial jitter to evaluate sensitivity. Table 7 shows that while navigation success rate (SR) decreases with noise addition, it degrades significantly more when 3D representation quality is compromised.' However, Table 7 includes only rows for SLAM noise and depth noise, and no rows for any feature dropout or spatial jitter experiment. The claimed 'significantly more' degradation is not supported by the data presented.

The text references 'the 3.8 billion-parameter LLaVA-Phi-3-mini [52, 53]'. Reference [52] is 'XTuner Contributors. XTuner: A toolkit for efficiently fine-tuning LLMs. https://github.com/InternLM/xtuner, 2023.' XTuner is a fine-tuning toolkit, not the original source or a describing paper for the LLaVA-Phi-3-mini model. This is a misattribution; a proper citation should point to the model's origin (e.g., the LLaVA framework with the Phi-3 language model) rather than a training utility.
